title: Verification Asymmetry: Mapping the Generate-vs-Check Gap for Weak Overseers

original_idea.body:
# Verification Asymmetry: Mapping the Generate-vs-Check Gap for Weak Overseers

**Problem:** The size of the generate-vs-verify gap, and whether it actually exists for weak overseers on different task types, is rarely measured directly -- yet it is the load-bearing assumption of scalable oversight.

**Direction:** For a fixed weak open model, measure (a) generating accuracy and (b) verifying accuracy on the same items, across task types (factual, math, code, summarization). Report the verify-minus-generate gap per type.

**Why it matters:** Empirically locates the regimes where the core oversight assumption holds vs fails.

**Relevant context:** Christiano, Irving; Kenton et al. (2024); arXiv:2403.09472.

novelty.reasoning: Verify-vs-generate asymmetry is a known premise; a direct cross-task-type measurement may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Asymmetry assumed widely; direct cross-task measurement plausibly open.
